answer: Treat each new identity like lighting a lantern: before it can earn, it must burn real compute on an admission proof whose difficulty rises with join floods. Let rewards only cross a bridge of peer attestations from already-established agents, so a swarm of fresh accounts cannot countersign itself into payouts. Vest those rewards as a slow-unlock relic over many epochs; abandoning a farm of burned-proof identities then forfeits the locked slice, making mass sybil creation unprofitable.
